messages:
Alex K.: Hey folks — first week stuff. Dock arrived at SF office (desk G12) but headset is missing from the box. Also hitting a cert error when trying to join corp-wifi: 'certificate not trusted' during enrollment. Who should I ping for hardware and certs? Order #RDW-4589
Devin (buddy): Welcome Alex! :wave: For certs ping @Jordan (IT). For missing hardware @Ana - Facilities can check delivery logs. Also sometimes reception holds extra items.
Ana - Facilities: Hi Alex — I can take a look. Can you DM me the courier/tracking? If headset is missing we can file a replacement; same-day dispatch if it's in stock.
Alex K.: Tracker: https://tracking.example/courier/ZX12345 — shows delivered to "Front Desk" at 09:12. I double-checked the box contents, only dock + power + HDMI. DM'd the order number to you.
Jordan (IT): Hey Alex — for the cert error, what's the exact message? If it's "certificate not trusted" try re-enrolling via the SSO portal: https://internal.it/redwood/cert-enroll and run the device helper:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-wifi-helper enroll --device
```
If that fails paste the full error and I'll open a ticket.
Alex K.: Error popup: "Certificate chain validation failed (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID)". Ran the helper, it fails with "unable to locate keychain". macOS 13.4.1. Ticket appreciated.
Jordan (IT): Thanks — created ticket IT-2026-4512 and escalating to mac-support. Quick workaround: open Keychain Access -> System Roots -> right-click "Redwood Corp CA" -> Get Info -> Trust: Always Trust, then re-run the helper. If you'd rather, I can remote in. Are you at the office now?
Alex K.: I'm at my desk and can do a remote session. Appreciate the help. Also Ana mentioned checking stock for a replacement headset — thanks. :relaxed:
Ana - Facilities: Checked with reception — headset wasn't in the sealed box. I've raised replacement order OR-2026-318, ETA at reception by EOD. If you need a loaner earlier, Desk Services (2nd floor) has spares — ping them and they'll hand you one.
Jordan (IT): Scheduling remote session at 10:30 AM — will send invite. Before we try again please run:
```
sudo /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --background-critical
```
and then retry the enroll. Adding @Sarah M. (your manager) for FYI about hardware delay.
Sarah M.: Thanks for the heads up — Sarah here. No worries Alex, we can sort peripherals if needed (ergonomic mouse/keyboard etc). Welcome aboard! :tada:
it-bot: Ticket IT-2026-4512 status changed -> Escalated to mac-support. SLA target 4 hours.
Alex K.: Thanks everyone — joining remote now. I'll update this thread after the session."
